    Hi Bornaa, Ana and I scouted the trail last week. It is not necessary to use th stairs, since there is an alternative route. HOwever, the stairs are viable and we went though them without any problem. But they are officially marked as not accessible. We spoke with the locals and they confirmed that people use them regularly. What we are planning to is to have people decide which route to take: (1) the stairs (2) the back route. Than Ana and I will lead the two groups. The reason to take the stairs is that they are a more fun and spectacular way to get to the top. But again, THEY ARE NOT NEEDED to get to the place where we will observe the dinosaurs' footprint and practice meditation at the sunset. On the way back in the twilight we will take the backroute anyway.
